help.en: How clear or murky is the water?
help.hi: Paani kitna saaf ya dhundhla hai?

help.en: How much plastic, trash or waste can you see in or near the water?
help.hi: Paani mein ya kinare pe kitna plastic ya kachra dikh raha hai?

help.en: How much natural plant cover is on the stream banks?
help.hi: Kinaron pe kitni hariyali / paudhe hain?

help.en: Do you see foam, oily shine or a film on the water surface?
help.hi: Paani ki satah pe jhaag, tel ki chamak ya parat dikh rahi hai?

help.en: Is the water flowing or is it still/stagnant?
help.hi: Paani beh raha hai ya ruka hua hai?
